method: Connected circular correlator C(t)=mean_{cfg,time}[O(time) O(time+t)]-(mean_{cfg,time} O)^2. Stationary block bootstrap resamples configurations with circular contiguous blocks within each of four independent chains. 600 replicates per block size; descriptive only.
caveats: Four chains per geometry; finite sample autocorrelations remain uncertain.
Mass fit requires stable positive later-time correlators and model/window robustness.
Legacy masked and complete auxiliary datasets are not pooled.
Stage19 chains are descendants of Stage9 and not independent of Stage17/18 descendants.
